name_en: The emperor's way: from 九洲清晏 to the audience halls
name_zh: 九洲清晏至正大光明御路
note: The emperor lived on 九洲清晏 and held the daily audience 御园听政 in 勤政殿, the great ones in 正大光明殿 (texts TX-012 to TX-016, TX-136). No Qing text says how he crossed the 前湖: by the east bridge 如意桥 is our choice (the plan leads from it straight to 勤政殿; 1860 witnesses saw the lake bridged at each end, TX-008, TX-010); the west bridge 南大桥 and a boat from the landing before 圆明园殿 (YMC-023) are the other readings. Order of the halls on the axis from S01; the names at 九洲清晏 are of 1873 (Q36).

name_en: The processional way: from 大宫门 to 正大光明
note: The stone road 石路 and the 辇道 before 大宫门 (S01 draws them, 日下旧闻考 j80:7b), the gate, the court with the 朝房, the bridge over the moon-shaped stream, 出入贤良门 and the paved court axis to the hall: the 1744 leaf P0001 shows the court, bridge, gate and axis (album AL-001, AL-003). The text names three bridges (驾石桥三); the leaf and S01 draw one.

name_en: The Xiyang Lou axis: west to east along the European palaces
note: Building to building in the order of the plates and the plan; the plates show the axis through 养雀笼 and the gates of 线法山 (album rows of P0041-P0060). The only pre-1860 account of moving through the strip, the 1856 day (TX-007), went 黄花磴 - 海晏堂 - 转马台 - a small corner gate, on horseback. Between the buildings the way is C: the plan draws openings, not the paving.

The emperor toured 福海 by boat: in 1856 from the landing at 雷峰夕照 in the boat 如在天上 (TX-001); 蓬岛瑶台 was reached only by boat, landing at 镜中阁 (TX-080); the dragon-boat races were watched from 望瀛洲 and 蓬岛瑶台, under Jiaqing from 澄虚榭 (TX-029 to TX-032). The order round the lake and the line on the water are ours (C); the landings are C except 蓬岛瑶台 south and 澄虚榭 (B, S01).
